cc:Work.dc:title: WallMounted - WallRack
cc:Work.dc:description:
Wall mountable rack for spices or other items
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes WallRack --top_edge G --Mounting_style 'straight edge, extended' --Mounting_num 3 --sh '90*2' --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes WallRack --Mounting_style --Mounting_num --sh --reference --labels
